build.formatjsRustBefore: Bazel -c opt: opt-level=3, embed-bitcode=no, no cross-crate LTO
build.formatjsRustAfter: Bazel -c opt; SDK archive transition enables ThinLTO in both Linux/macOS release archives
build.workloads: Identical frozen Hermes -O bytecode on all applicable hosts
build.scope: LTO is scoped to SDK release archive transitions; repository-wide build defaults unchanged.

clock: Every host uses monotonic high-resolution __now(); before and after have identical console-only steady_clock patch. Full suite now uses __now() too, with Date.now fallback for other hosts.
benchmarkScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
bootstrap="$PWD/$(rg '\.hbc$' /tmp/hermes-plural-magrinj-bytecode-path)"
run_variant() {
 case "$1" in
  before) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-list-inline-final-hires "$2" ;;
  after) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-thin-lto-hires "$2" ;;
  magrinj) FORMATJS_BENCH_BOOTSTRAP="$bootstrap" taskset -c 0 /tmp/hi-host-optimized "$2" ;;
 esac
}
run_case() {
 local label="$1" workload="$2"
 for variant in $variants; do
  run_variant "$variant" "$workload" > "/tmp/hermes-thin-lto-${label:+$label-}$variant-$round.jsonl"
 done
}
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case '' /tmp/hermes-list-default-overlap.hbc
 run_case tag /tmp/hermes-canonical-control.hbc
 run_case size /tmp/hermes-list-size-control.hbc
 run_case locale /tmp/hermes-canonical-locale-control.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case constructor /tmp/hermes-list-constructor-control.hbc
 run_case relative /tmp/hermes-rtf-bridge-control.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='after before'; else variants='before after'; fi
 run_case full /tmp/hermes-all-api-optimized.hbc
done
profileScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
cp -f "$(rg '\.hbc$' /tmp/hermes-all-api-bytecode-path)" /tmp/hermes-all-api-optimized.hbc
for variant in before after; do
 if [ "$variant" = before ]; then host=/tmp/hermes-list-inline-final-hires; else host=/tmp/hermes-thin-lto-hires; fi
 for label in format decimal list locale; do
  case "$label" in
   format) workload=relative-format-profile.js ;;
   decimal) workload=relative-decimal-profile.js ;;
   list) workload=list-format-profile.js ;;
   locale) workload=locale-cold-profile.js ;;
  esac
  taskset -c 0 "$host" -sample-profiling=chrome -sample-profiling-freq=1000 -profiling-out="/tmp/hermes-thin-lto-$label-$variant.cpuprofile" "benchmarks/hermes-intl-extension/$workload" > "/tmp/hermes-thin-lto-$label-$variant.log" 2>&1
 done
 "$host" /tmp/hermes-benchmark-clock-check.js > "/tmp/hermes-thin-lto-clock-$variant.json"
done
bash /tmp/hermes-thin-lto-run.sh
order: Three complete 33-case overlap invocations plus tag, Locale and list-size controls per host. Rounds 1 and 3 before/after/magrinj; round 2 reverses. Constructor and RTF controls follow, same alternating order. Full API suite runs afterward on before/after only, three rounds, reverse round2. CPU0 throughout. No builds or profiling during timings.
outputChecks: 459 shared values checked (297 overlap, 27 tag,18 Locale,45 list-size,36 constructor,36 relative). Native before/after values match; comparator differences only omitted/unsupported ListFormat default en-US versus en. All 84 full-API native/TS output assertions pass (14 scenarios, two SDK hosts, three invocations each). Full-suite outputs checked inside workload before timing; checksum is a timing sink, not a cross-host equality assertion.
change: Enable cross-crate ThinLTO on SDK archives using the existing rules_rust build setting, allowing the Rust release optimizer to see formatter dependencies. No Rust/JS/C++ implementation changes. Full API harness now uses optimized bytecode, high-resolution timing and sufficient calibration limit.
